currentArtifact.question:
[단답형 1]
식 $\frac{{}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{0} - {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{1} + {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{2} - \cdots + (-1)^{11}{}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{11}}{(1+x)^{11}}$의 값을 $\mathrm{A}$,
식 ${}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{1} + 2 \times {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{2} + 3 \times {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{3} + \cdots + 11 \times {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{11}$ 의 값을 $\mathrm{B}$라 할 때, $\frac{\mathrm{A+B}}{2^6}$ 의 값을 구하여 정수로 쓰시오. [4.0점]

officialSolutionPdf.observed: 공식 풀이가 분자를 (1+x)^11로 바꾸어 분모와 소거하고, x=-1을 제외값으로 표시한 뒤 A=0으로 계산한다.

mathematicalAdjudication.naturalDomain: For real x, the displayed rational expression has natural domain ℝ\{-1}; the denominator makes x=-1 inadmissible without an extra stem clause.
mathematicalAdjudication.valueOnDomain: For every x in the natural domain, the numerator equals (1-1)^11=0 and the denominator is nonzero, so A=0 uniquely.
mathematicalAdjudication.result: B=11264 and (A+B)/64=176 for every admissible x.
mathematicalAdjudication.officialIntent: The official solution itself marks x=-1 as excluded and gives 176. This resolves the R2 reviewer caveat using source authority.

decision.reason: For a rational expression, its natural domain excludes values making the denominator zero. The expression has the same value 0 for every admissible x, and the official solution explicitly confirms this interpretation. Adding x≠−1 to the student prompt would be redundant and is not required to make the requested value unique.
